pages.title: Early Warning
pages.text: In $(bold)Phase 1$() it first reports a cooling trend, then warns that $(bold)persistent rain$() is coming.$(br2)Hover its $(bold)WARNING$() field for advice: heat, fuel, food, warm shelter.$(br2)It reads the climate, not the next shower.

pages.title: Phase 6
pages.text: It tracks each sub-stage and warns of whiteout, thinning air and $(danger)vacuum onset$().$(br2)Place it in a shelter or workroom.
Copper and glass.$(br2)$(flavor)ORSA stopped promising dates when the models started missing by the hour.$()
